name: [🥳BACK]  Half Life: City 8
desc:
[ℝℙ/𝕋𝔻𝕄] Half-Life, City-08.

With the surrender of humanity in the Seven Hour War, you must survive in the remains of Tokyo, now known as City 8 under the Combine's control. After an incident involving a rebel known as Alyx taking down the Combine Vault in City-17, the combine has began to strengthen it's grip on humanity within all Urban Centers.

Will you:
> Pledge to the Combine as a Loyalist?
> Serve as part of Civil Protection?
> Rebel against the Combine's oppression?

You decide your own fate within City-08.

⭐ Join the City-8 Community Group: https://www.roblox.com/groups/13426157/Click-Here
